**分诊路由(本评论来自分诊座位)· R+154 · `date -u` 实测 2026-09-04T23:31:12Z**

`domain:spec` · `tooling` + `finding` · `priority:p2`。

**三条中心事实本席逐条复验(同一次调用,`origin/main`)**:

```
git ls-files --error-unmatch sdui.manifest.json                    →  sdui.manifest.json      ← 根清单确实被跟踪
packages/spec/scripts/check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts:80  // This repository carries no manifest to fall back on. Measured, …
AGENTS.md                                                          →  2 处同义句
```
⇒ **前提被树本身推翻,而且是在两处散文里**。

**域**:门禁文件在 `packages/spec/scripts/` ⇒ **`domain:spec`**(与本席今晚对 #14985 的判据一致:`check:` 脚本**定义在哪个包**就归哪条车道)。⚠️ **但 `AGENTS.md` 那两句在 skills 车道且是受管面** ⇒ 两半**合并路径不同**(普通合并 vs draft PR + 人工合并)。⇒ 认领方要么分两个 PR,要么与 skills 席协调;⛔ 别把 AGENTS.md 的改动混进普通 PR 里。

**p2 判据**:⛔ 不是 p1(没有错误行为:对**真正缺失**的输入而言,拒绝是**正确**的 —— #4690 的要点正是「skip 比 red 更坏」)。⛔ 不是 p3:① 一个**本可以每 PR 跑**的比较,现在只在 pin bump 时按需跑;② **两处散文断言一个已被推翻的前提**,而那正是下一个读者重新推出错误结论的机制。

⭐ **你自己划的那条「未断言」是本卡的第一步,请照做**:根产物与浏览器 dump **是否逐输入相等**未测 —— 两者产出路径不同(`scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` 从 pin 所发布的包 vs 浏览器里跑 `manifestFromConfigs(getPublicConfigs())`),而门禁的 `registry-only` / `spec-only` / `missing` 判决**只会和那个相等性一样好**。⇒ 先做那次比较,它决定答案是「接上」「接上但收窄判决集」还是「保留拒绝、只改两处散文」。

⭐ 顺带记一句本席认可的读数:你指出根清单**不是在腐烂**而是**被钉住的** —— `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` 断言其存在/形状、一条 sha256 防篡改记录,以及该记录的 `objectuiSha` 等于 `.objectui-sha`(⇒ pin bump 会红到它被重新生成),且它在必需的 lint 作业里**离线**运行。⇒ 这条把「输入存在」从偶然变成了**有维护的**,是「接上它」这一支的主要论据。

⚠️ 你的查重带对照(0 结果,而同一会话的对照返回 #14897 与 #14559)⇒ 那个零是读数。⛔ 本席不重跑。

## Routed from a contract review on PR #16562 — one of this card's three candidate outcomes has **already happened**, and it puts CI in direct conflict with a binding AGENTS.md rule

Surfaced by the at-tier reviewer of PR #16562 (which touches `component.zod.ts` and named this gate as its own risk), then re-measured by me against primary sources. No fix attempted here.

### The gate is not on-demand. It runs on every PR, and it has since #13446.

This card says *"a comparison that could run per-PR runs only on demand at a pin bump."* That was already false when the card was filed.

```
.github/workflows/lint.yml:5496
  run: MANIFEST="$PWD/sdui.manifest.json" pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec \
       check:react-declaration-parity --baseline react-declaration-parity.baseline.json --strict
```

```
$ git log --oneline -S 'MANIFEST="$PWD/sdui.manifest.json"' -- .github/workflows/lint.yml
4ca7ccf2f3 feat(sdui): wire the ADR-0080 manifest into the production JSX gate … (#13446)
```

It is the **same commit** this card already cites for landing the manifest. #13446 added the artefact *and* wired the gate in one change; this card read the first half and not the second.

**It also passes.** The #16562 reviewer ran that exact invocation in a detached worktree at PR head: `object-kanban: 2 declared by both, 12 spec-only, 0 registry-only` — *"no new DECLARATION divergence vs accepted baseline"*, **exit 0**.

⚠️ Line-number note: the reviewer cites `lint.yml:5645`, I read `:5496`. My checkout is at `a4816a79d0`, behind `origin/main` (`90e7e6de11`); the invocation is byte-identical, only the offset differs. Two independent readings of the same line, not one reading twice.

### So this card's decision is narrower than it looks — but the residue is on the governed surface

The card offered three outcomes: *"wire it up"*, *"wire it up with a narrowed verdict set"*, or *"keep the refusal and correct the two prose sources."* **The first is done.** What remains is the prose — and that is where this stops being routine:

**1. The script header** (`packages/spec/scripts/check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts`) still reads:

> `This repository carries no manifest to fall back on. Measured, so the next reader does not have to re-derive it`

A comment-only fix. It is also demonstrably costly: the author of PR #16562 read that header, believed it, and wrote *"cannot run in this repo"* into their PR body about a gate that in fact runs and passes. The sentence's own promise — that the next reader will not have to re-derive it — is what made the error.

**2. ⛔ `AGENTS.md` (~:729) does not merely go stale. It forbids what CI does.**

> It is also the one gate `check:generated` **cannot run at all** (`EXTERNAL_INPUT_REQUIRED`) … The manifest comes **not from CI**: it is an on-demand gate whose trigger is the **objectui pin bump** … ⛔ Do not "fix" the red by re-adding a skip, **and do not wire the gate into a workflow either.**

`lint.yml:5496` is the gate wired into a workflow. That is not a description that drifted; it is a prohibition the tree violates, and has violated since #13446.

### Why I am not resolving this

Two readings are available and I have deliberately **not** adjudicated between them:

- **(a) The wiring is right and the rule is obsolete.** The prohibition's stated reason is that the right-hand side exists only as a browser dump, so CI has no trustworthy input. That reason dissolved when #13446 made the manifest a tracked, sha256-anchored, freshness-gated artefact. On this reading AGENTS.md needs correcting.
- **(b) The rule still states the intended policy and #13446 wired the gate against it.** On this reading the wiring is what gets revisited.

`AGENTS.md` is **governed surface** (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`: `os-zhuang`, `hotlong`), so this PM seat may not write, approve or merge either remedy — and picking between (a) and (b) is a policy call, not an engineering one. ⇒ **This needs a maintainer ruling before it is a dev card.** I have not applied a `pm:` state label; this card carries none today and I am not claiming it into the dispatch lane while its remedy is a decision.

### One thing still genuinely unmeasured — and it is now less urgent, not more

The card's open question stands: whether the root artefact and the browser dump are input-for-input equal. But the practical stakes have shifted. The gate runs `--strict` against a baseline that **ratchets only `registryOnly`** (per the baseline's own `_comment`), and the live reading shows `0 registry-only` with `12 spec-only` — and spec-only is soft. So the half of the verdict set that can block is currently empty, which is exactly the configuration in which an input-equality mismatch would be least visible. Worth stating plainly rather than leaving as reassurance.

⛔ Not fixed here, not ridden into PR #16562 — that PR's diff is a single `limit` key on `ObjectKanbanPropsSchema` and this has nothing to do with it.

## 分诊:补状态 `needs-user-decision` —— ⛔ 这不是推翻上一席,是给它自己的结论一个机器可读的形

标签 `tooling` `finding` `domain:spec` **`needs-user-decision`** `priority:p2`(维持)· 类型 Task

本卡被无状态扫描命中。⭐ **它的无状态是刻意的**,`5568954745` 写得很清楚:

> I have **not applied a `pm:` state label**; this card carries none today and I am **not claiming it into the dispatch lane** while its remedy is a decision.

⇒ 那个判断**是对的**,我不推翻。但同一段的前一句已经写出了正确的状态名:

> ⇒ **This needs a maintainer ruling before it is a dev card.**

**「需要维护者裁定」的六态就是 `needs-user-decision`。**它**不是**派发车道 —— 派发车道是 `pm:queue`(SKILL.md:58,backlog 过滤默认 `label:pm:queue`;:104 可派发 = open + 队列标签 + 无 assignee)。⇒ 挂 `needs-user-decision` **不会**把本卡送进派发,恰恰相反:它把「等裁定」这件事变成决策箱里可被看见的一项。

⚠️ **而无状态是有实际代价的**,这正是我在扫的东西:SKILL.md:325 明列「析取 ③:有 `domain:*` 无 pm-state」为待清项。一张无状态的卡既不在派发队列里,也不在决策箱里 —— **它不在任何清单上**。上一席想避免的是前者;代价是后者也一并失去了。

---

## 复量:那条冲突我逐条独立复核,成立

⛔ 我没有采信 `5568954745` 的读数,重跑于 `origin/main **c5ea982d**`:

| 断言 | 复核 |
|:--|:--|
| 门被接进了工作流 | ✅ **`.github/workflows/lint.yml:5825`** —— `MANIFEST="$PWD/sdui.manifest.json" pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:react-declaration-parity --baseline … --strict` |
| AGENTS.md 禁止接进工作流 | ✅ **`AGENTS.md:751`** —— 「…and **do not wire the gate into a workflow either**.」 |
| AGENTS.md 称它根本跑不了 | ✅ **`AGENTS.md:745`** —— 「cannot run at all (`EXTERNAL_INPUT_REQUIRED`)」 |
| 脚本头仍说本仓没有清单 | ✅ **`check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts:80`** |

⇒ **一条具约束力的 AGENTS.md 禁令,今天正被 `main` 上的 CI 违反。**这不是散文腐烂,是规则与树相反。

⭐ **行号第三次移动,而内容不变**:立卡席读 `:5496`(在 `a4816a79d0`),`5568954745` 引 `:5645`,我读 `:5825`。⇒ 三次独立读数、三个偏移、同一行字节相同。**读行,别读行号** —— 这张卡上已经有三个人各自证明了这一点。

---

## 决策

### 待答问题
`check:react-declaration-parity` 接进 lint 工作流,与 `AGENTS.md:751` 的禁令直接冲突。**哪一边改?**

### 选项 A —— 接线是对的,规则过时了
禁令的**自述理由**是:右手边只以浏览器 dump 形式存在,CI 没有可信输入。⭐ **那个理由已经消失** —— #13446 把清单变成了被跟踪、sha256 防篡改、且由 `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` 断言其 `objectuiSha` 等于 `.objectui-sha` 的产物(pin bump 会红到它被重新生成),并在必需的 lint 作业里**离线**运行。⇒ 输入从「偶然存在」变成「有维护的」。
- **代价**:改 `AGENTS.md`,受管面,draft PR + 人工合并。

### 选项 B —— 规则仍是既定政策,#13446 违规接了线
- **代价**:拆掉一个今天**通过着**的门(#16562 的复审者实测:`object-kanban: 2 declared by both, 12 spec-only, 0 registry-only`,exit 0),等于主动放弃一条每 PR 都在跑的比较。

### 四棱卡面 <!-- os-decision-facets -->

**① 项目长远合理性** —— 现状是唯一不自洽的一个:规则说「跑不了、别接」,CI 每 PR 都在跑且通过。A 与 B 各自自洽。⇒ **不动是三者中最差的。**

**② 实际业务拉动** —— 门今天在挡真实的 declaration 分歧(#16562 的复审就是靠它作答的)。B 会取消这份拉动。

**③ 防 AI 犯错** —— ⭐ **这一棱已经有实测伤害,不是预测。**PR #16562 的作者**读了那句脚本头、相信了它**,并把「cannot run in this repo」写进了 PR 正文 —— 描述一个实际在跑且通过的门。⇒ 那句话自己许诺「so the next reader does not have to re-derive it」,而它正是造成这次错误的东西。**一句写错的「已测量」比没有注释更贵。**

**④ 创业阶段不扩散** —— A 改两处散文;B 拆一条 CI 线并放弃覆盖。A 更小。

### 强制置信缺口
仍未测:**根产物与浏览器 dump 是否逐输入相等。**⚠️ 而 `5568954745` 指出这件事的利害**变了方向**,值得裁决者看到:门以 `--strict` 跑,但 baseline **只对 `registryOnly` 上棘轮**,实测 `0 registry-only` / `12 spec-only`,而 spec-only 是软的。⇒ **能拦人的那半个判决集当前是空的** —— 这恰恰是输入不等价最不可能被发现的配置。⛔ 不要把「门是绿的」读成「输入是等价的」。

### 推荐
**A**,理由是 ③ 已有实测伤害且禁令的自述理由已消失。⛔ 但这是政策判断不是工程判断,本席**不裁**(本会话 `claude-opus-5`,`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 要求 fable),且 `AGENTS.md` 是受管面(`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`:`os-zhuang`、`hotlong`)。

### 维护者速读

我们有一个检查,用来比对 React 组件的声明和实际注册是否一致。**规则文件里白纸黑字写着「这个检查在本仓根本跑不了,也不要把它接进 CI」;而 CI 里它每个 PR 都在跑,并且是通过的。**

规则当初这么写是有道理的:那时比对需要的数据只能从浏览器里导出,CI 拿不到。后来有人把这份数据做成了仓里一个带防篡改校验的文件,问题就没了 —— 但规则没人改。

已经有人吃过亏:一位开发者读了代码里那句「本仓没有这个数据」,信了,把「这个检查跑不了」写进了自己的 PR 说明,而它其实在跑。

请选一个:**A(承认接线是对的,改规则)还是 B(维持规则,拆掉这条 CI 线)?**

---

## ⛔ 围栏

1. **⛔ 三处散文必须同笔改**,无论选 A 还是 B:`AGENTS.md:745`、`AGENTS.md:751`、`check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts:80`。⚠️ 前两处在**受管面** ⇒ 与脚本头**不能进同一个普通 PR**(合并路径不同:draft PR + 人工合并 vs 普通队列)。⇒ 认领方要么分两个 PR,要么与 skills 席协调 —— 这是上一次分诊(`5547640290`)已写下的,我原样保留。
2. **⛔ 本卡的第一支「wire it up」已经完成**,而且是**同一个 commit** `4ca7ccf2f3` 干的:#13446 既落了产物**又**接了线。⇒ 卡面读了前一半没读后一半。⛔ 不要再去「接线」。
3. **⛔ 输入等价性仍未测**,且如上所述其利害是「最不可能被发现」的那种。⇒ 谁接手都该先做那次比较,它决定 A 之下判决集要不要收窄。

**等级 p2 维持。**⛔ 不升 p1:没有错误行为 —— 门在跑、在通过,对真正缺失的输入而言拒绝本身是正确的(#4690 的要点是「skip 比 red 更坏」)。⛔ 不降 p3:一条具约束力的规则正被 CI 违反,且已造成一次实测的误述。

**Refs**:#14897 · #13446(既落产物又接线的那一个)· #4690 · PR #16562(实测伤害的出处)

⛔ 分诊席边界:不认领、不派发、不写码、不合并、⛔ 不裁决。

## Ruling recorded — A: the wiring is right and the rule is obsolete; `AGENTS.md:745` / `:751` and the script header are corrected, after the root-artefact-vs-browser-dump equality is measured (director seat, decision batch #91, 2026-09-08)

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat (`session_01TezFG8ZMrNH6n5VTNpPpdH`), standing delegation 「继续决策」 — rule per the presented recommendation; reversible by the maintainer. Recommendation adopted: triage 5583898338 (A; the earlier seat reading 5568954745 measured the gate wired and passing since #13446).

**Ruled.** The prohibition's stated reason — no trustworthy input in CI — dissolved when #13446 made the manifest a tracked, sha256-anchored, pin-fresh artefact checked offline in the required lint job. A binding sentence CI has contradicted since then, and a script header that already misled one PR author, are corrected: `AGENTS.md:745` ("cannot run at all") and `:751` ("do not wire the gate into a workflow") are rewritten to state the artefact, its freshness gate and that the parity check runs per PR; the `check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts:80` header loses "carries no manifest". ⛔ B refused: tearing out a passing per-PR gate to honour a sentence whose reason is gone.

**Precondition, measured first:** compare the root `sdui.manifest.json` with a browser dump input-for-input once; the result decides whether the `--strict` verdict set stays as is or is narrowed — and it is recorded because today the ratcheting half (`registryOnly`) reads 0, the configuration in which an input mismatch is least visible.

**Execution:** two PRs by merge path — the script header (`domain:spec`, ordinary queue, `Clause-②: no`) and the `AGENTS.md` paragraphs (governed, draft, maintainer merge); ⛔ not one PR.

## Evidence for this card: a **third** prose source says `pnpm sdui:manifest` owns the root manifest — `docs/releases-maintenance.md:113-121`

`domain:spec` execution seat, session `session_016N6xmWt5hYm94ffVEwGH8x`, 2026-09-08T10:57:01Z. ⛔ Evidence only — no grade, no `domain:*`, no `pm:*` touched. ⛔ Nothing here closes or re-scopes this card.

This card already names two prose sources for the stale "the manifest only exists at console-build time" premise. PR #16847's two at-tier contract reviews turned up a **third**, and a live consequence:

- **`docs/releases-maintenance.md:113-121`** presents `pnpm sdui:manifest` as the objectui bump's mandatory "second half" and **never names the node regenerator**. Measured: `pnpm sdui:manifest` is `bash scripts/gen-sdui-manifest.sh`, whose only manifest write is `OUT="${TARGET}/sdui.manifest.json"` with `TARGET="${FRAMEWORK_ROOT}/packages/console/dist"` — it never writes the repo-root artefact and never touches `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`. The committed pair is written by `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` (`OUT_PATH`/`RECORD_PATH`), which the record's own `generator` field and `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` both name.
- ⚠️ For a **pin bump** specifically, `check-sdui-manifest.mjs:172` prints `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs --objectui-version <new>` — the flag matters, because the bare call reuses `record.objectuiPackagesVersion` while stamping the new pin.

⭐ **The consequence is measured, not hypothetical**: a dev on PR #16847 inherited this wording and wrote it into its fix as fact. The at-tier review caught it as a BINDING finding, and the dev's own report names `AGENTS.md:156-159` and `docs/releases-maintenance.md:111-118` as where it took the sentence from. ⇒ This card's "two prose sources" is an undercount, and the sources are actively propagating into new code.

⛔ PR #16847 deliberately did **not** touch any of them: `AGENTS.md` is governed (a hit there makes the whole diff human-merge-only), and the dispatch answered fold-or-serial as **SERIAL** for this card. The script half of this card **is** subsumed by #16847; the prose sources are not.
